card.name: Day number in a calendar date
card.fires_on: Digits of the day-of-month in a written date, usually after a weekday and a month name (or before one), such as the 2 in 'August 12'. Seen in web page dates and event listings.

modes.label: Month then day
modes.description: The day number follows a month name, often after a weekday.

modes.label: Day then month
modes.description: The day number follows a weekday and comes before the month name.

card.plain: It marks the day number inside a written calendar date like 'Thursday, May 11'.
